title: Put the ork binary on PATH
lead: Seen 2026-10-20: 'ork: command not found'. The built binary lives in a scratch path. The owner and the relay sessions need to call ork directly. Check what docs say today; install is the owner's call (no system dirs).

sections.heading: Why

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - docs, a Makefile or script if the owner approves, README.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A documented install puts ork on the owner's PATH without sudo (for example go install to a user bin dir).
- ork doctor reports where the binary is.
